### Project Summary

-   **Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis**
    -   Developed deep learning models for automated detection and classification of diseases in medical images using CNNs and transfer learning.
    -   Implemented data augmentation techniques and preprocessing pipelines to handle imbalanced medical image datasets.
    -   Achieved 94% accuracy on disease classification tasks using ensemble methods combining ResNet, VGG, and Inception architectures.
    -   Collaborated with medical professionals to validate model predictions and ensure clinical relevance of the findings.
